variants.name: 100 g
variants.about_this_item:
Beaphar Duo Active is a two-colour multivitamin paste, a supplement for dogs and puppies from 6 weeks of age.

  • The yellow paste contains all the vitamins and minerals a dog needs to stay healthy and look good; omega-6 fatty acids for healthy skin and a beautiful coat; added L-carnitine strengthens the muscles and supports energy metabolism and endurance.
  • The brown conditioning paste contains extra minerals and BIO-MOS (mannan-oligosaccharides) to support a healthy intestinal flora.
  • 0% added sugar.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Oils and fats, milk and milk products, derivatives of vegetable origin (malt extract 3.8%, MOS 4,700 mg/kg), yeasts, minerals, cereals.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin B1 370 mg, vitamin B2 110 mg, vitamin B6 180 mg, vitamin B12 1,500 µg, calcium D-pantothenate 540 mg, nicotinamide 990 mg, biotin 320 µg, vitamin E 130 IU, folic acid 27 mg, L-carnitine 370 mg, antioxidants.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 16%, crude fibre 0.05%, crude oils and fats 52%, crude ash 4.2%, moisture 2.2%, calcium 0.55%, phosphorus 0.46%, sodium 0.41%, potassium 0.67%, magnesium 0.047%.
variants.feeding_instructions: Mix with food or give directly from the tube. Once a day, 3 cm of paste per 5 kg of body weight. Make sure fresh drinking water is available.
